Samira D.: Hey finance, corp card declined at a client dinner in Madrid so I covered the bill on my card + a cash tip. Total on my personal card was 142.50 EUR (incl tip 20 EUR). I uploaded the restaurant itemized receipt but the tip line wasn't printed (cash). How should I submit? Need to split client entertainment vs team meal?
Jonas H.: FYI the dinner included 2 customers + 2 Redwood folks. We marked it "product demo follow-up" on calendar.
expense-bot: For mixed business/personal charges: submit an expense with separate line items and attach receipts. Example:
```/expenses submit
line1: 122.50 EUR -> business - client meal, attach receipt_itemized.pdf
line2: 20.00 EUR -> personal - cash tip, attach tip_note.jpg
notes: "Client dinner 2025-09-04, attendees: Alice, Marco, Samira, Jonas; demo follow-up"```
Samira D.: Uploads: receipt_itemized.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/dinner_1762345678.pdf ; tip_note.jpg -> https://redwood-files/receipts/tip_1762345678.jpg
Avery (Finance): Thanks @Samira. A few things: 1) We need the attendee list and business purpose (you've got that) 2) For cash tips, either attach a photo of the tip receipt or a signed tip declaration. Tip amounts under 25 EUR are auto-approvable with manager sign-off. 3) Because a corporate card declined, confirm card_ending is 4321 so we can reconcile the declined txn on the ledger.
Samira D.: Card ending 4321. Attendees: Alice M. (Acme), Marco R. (Acme), Jonas H., Samira D. Purpose: follow-up demo and procurement discussion. Tip photo attached.
Avery (Finance): Okay. Two policy notes: client entertainment with external attendees is reimbursable but requires attendee names and business purpose (good). Alcohol is allowed but capped per-head; your submission will be reviewed for reasonableness. Also, since the corp card declined, we will mark the corp-card ledger for the attempted txn and process your personal reimbursement for the business portion (122.50 EUR). The 20 EUR tip should be submitted as personal and reimbursed only if you provide a signed tip declaration and manager approval.
Jonas H.: Approving manager sign-off for the tip. Approved.
corp-card-bot: Card decline matched to attempted transaction. Status: card-declined -> /expenses view 1762345678
Samira D.: Submitted split expense and tagged @Avery and @Jonas. Note included: "card declined at POS, paid personal; cash tip 20 EUR - manager approved."
Avery (Finance): Received. I'll process the 122.50 EUR to payroll as a reimbursement in the next cycle and route the tip to payroll for collection unless you provide a signed tip declaration. If you prefer, we can net the 20 EUR from next month's expense advance. Will update when posted.
Samira D.: Thanks! Appreciate the quick turnaround.
